destination.name: Ulladulla
destination.tagline: Harbour town and holiday base beside Mollymook, with a ladder walk to Pigeon House Mountain.
destination.description: Ulladulla is a coastal town on the Princes Highway about 230 km south of Sydney, halfway between Batemans Bay and Nowra. Wikivoyage calls it, with neighbouring Mollymook, a popular summer and weekend getaway for Sydneysiders. Mollymook Beach has a public golf course, and inland the steep walk to Pigeon House Mountain ends at Budawang cliffs.

goodToKnow.title: Pigeon House has ladders
goodToKnow.detail: The walk is steep with ladders near the summit; the brief lists track hours 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

goodToKnow.title: Summer cabins book out early
goodToKnow.detail: Wikivoyage says cabins book out early over summer, while weekdays in the off-peak season usually have vacancies.

goodToKnow.title: Mollymook is a walk away
goodToKnow.detail: Mollymook Beach is about a 45-minute walk from Ulladulla and has a public golf course popular with visitors.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are the summer holiday months, when Sydney visitors fill the beaches and cabins.
